digest.component_or_area: JiraConfig validation and cloud configuration schema
propositions: JiraConfig accepts non-https (http://) URLs without validation, creating cleartext credential exposure risk, while the analogous DC ReconcilerConfig rejects them unless allow_insecure is set.

Three consumers of load_config().jira (resolve_jira_settings, _jira_onboard._detect, write_jira_config) silently swallow ConfigError, bypassing scheme validation even if added at the JiraConfig level.
The onboarding wizard (write_jira_config) persists jira.url to disk without scheme validation, allowing cleartext URLs to be written to the config file.
JiraConfig lacks an allow_insecure field and __post_init__ validator to enforce https-only URLs and provide an override mechanism parallel to ReconcilerConfig.allow_insecure.
